	<ResortReportHeadline>Magic Monday!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It looks like another pearler of a day on the mountain, so get out there and make the most of it!&nbsp; The wind has picked up to a stiff northerly, but the sky is clear and there will be plenty of fun turns to be had.&nbsp; It dropped to zero overnight, the current temp is 2 degrees, and we are heading for a top of 6 degrees.</p><p>The snow has set-up again overnight, so will start the day off firm before the sunny aspects soften as the day warms.&nbsp; South facing slopes may stay slick and best avoided for much of the day. The groomed runs will certainly be the best option first thing, while some off-piste options will be worth looking at once they have softened with some sun.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Due to the shallow cover, the Village Loop and Heavenly Valley have been upgraded to advanced skiers and riders only, and the opening of Heavenly Valley will be delayed until it softens enough.&nbsp;</p><p>Slap on the screen and follow the sun for fun turns all day.&nbsp;</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>
